name: transmitter_show
description: Hand the person the RC transmitter: a handheld two-stick radio that drives the truck and flies the drone. It appears between their hands if both are tracked, else just in front of them below eye level. They pick it up by closing a hand round it (one or both hands) and drive with their thumbs on the sticks; letting go of a stick centres it, and putting the transmitter down stops the truck or makes the drone hover. Truck: left stick throttle, right stick steering, buttons Horn and Reset. Drone (mode 2): left stick climbs and turns, right stick flies forward, back and sideways; buttons Take off/Land and Home/Reset; the switch picks easy steering (away from you is forward) or pro (the nose is forward). It already appears by itself when a truck or drone course opens. Use it when the person asks for the controller, the remote, the transmitter or the sticks, or asks how to drive or fly. Nothing is sent anywhere, so no confirmation is needed.

name: transmitter_hide
description: Put the RC transmitter away: it lets go of both sticks (the truck coasts to a stop, the drone hovers) and disappears until transmitter_show or a new course brings it back. Use it when the person says put the controller away, hide the remote, or they are done driving.
